purpose: Inventario maestro reconciliado de seis perspectivas de agente, el maestro anterior y el estado fisico actual de la cadena ARICA/Fondart.

mission.statement: MAK es un sistema operativo reusable para convertir archivos artisticos extensos en memoria de evidencia, conocimiento cultural y curatorial revisable, portfolio, dossier, postulacion y research, con aprendizaje incremental y sin exigir revision humana como gate normal.
mission.generalization_unit: one person or artist archive with years of finished work and process traces
mission.forbidden_shortcut: No convertir una tarea, un caso, un filename, una similitud o un draft en la arquitectura ni en verdad artistica.

source_packets.contribution: Distingue herramienta disponible, capacidad integrada, conocimiento operativo y producto verificable; mapea Copilot, departamentos, RD triangular y capacidades historicas.
Define identidad fisica versus contenido, memoria temporal, replay, relaciones, unidades, Project IR y portabilidad entre archivos.
Formula la mision, el operating world, la supervision natural, representation learning, curaduria como compilacion y episodios como aprendizaje.
Aporta conservacion de identidad, procedencia, incertidumbre y significado a traves de toda proyeccion.
Aporta el modelo de control distribuido, departamentos, organos, Conductor, gates y prohibiciones de efectos externos implicitos.
Aporta sensing externo, Vigia, captura bounded, vigencia diferencial, triangulacion, evidencia ambiental y bucles de retorno.
Primera reconciliacion de las seis perspectivas y plan por fases; preservada como antecedente de esta version.
source_packets.hash_note: The prior master-v1 hashmap hash was observed only as a truncated 60-character command rendering after the file was replaced; it is intentionally null rather than presented as a false SHA-256. The six source-agent packets remain independently hash-verified.

dref_full_cross_context_probe.interpretation: The full DREF physical archive connects to reconstructed DREF contexts through other catalogued works, while Escarlata still connects through reconstructed DREFGIRA refs to HARRY. Same-artist physical and reconstructed contexts cannot share one archive identity without a declared context distinction; the probe therefore does not promote or merge them.

success_definition: A new archive can be observed and replayed without source mutation or identity loss.
Relationships and projects remain provisional until independently supported.
Practice evidence and opportunity evidence join only through explicit requirement bindings.
A single plan compiles dossier, portfolio, application and research outputs with full provenance and visible gaps.
Every relevant unknown becomes a bounded probe, a contradiction or an explained abstention.
Verified external outcomes can improve ranking and query selection under identity-separated holdout.
The controller selects and eventually executes only allowlisted finite actions with receipts and rollback.
No case name, manual review gate or bespoke ARICA rule is required for the reusable core.
